properties.property: (begin (define talk-id "030-cityhall-king-talk") (if (!get talk-id) (begin (dialog '(("/hero" "H-Hello.") ("king/king-1" "Hello, you must be {{hero}}! Nice to meet you. I heard you were heading to these parts.\nMy name is Xe III and I am the King of this Region.") ("king/king-1_happy" "Do not confuse me with the King of Evil, I am good haha.") ("king/king-1" "So… tell me, how are you? Is everything okay? How is the journey going?") ("/hero" "Everything good, I just defeated the Hoarfrost Team and I got the first signet!") ("king/king-1_happy" "Oh really?! This is great news!") ("king/king-1" "It has been difficult?"))) (define id "030-cityhall-question-difficult") (answer id '(("Yes, quite a lot" . #t) ("Just a little" . #f))) (wait) (if (get id) (dialog '(("king/king-1" "Well, but if you did it, it means that you are strong!"))) (dialog '(("king/king-1" "Well, congratulations! This means that you are strong!")))) (dialog '(("king/king-1" "I trust that you will be able to take the other two signets as well.") ("king/king-1" "Since you're heading east, can you do me a favour? Could you deliver this package to the King of the Water Region? It is a few kilometers east of here.") ("/hero" "Yes of course, I'll give it to him.") ("king/king-1" "Thank you very much. Here's to you."))) (wait) (give-item "30.package-of-the-king") (dialog '(("king/king-1" "Be careful not to drop it, it is fragile.") ("/hero" "Sure, I'll be careful.") ("king/king-1" "Thank you again.\nI wish you a good journey, come back anytime."))) (set talk-id #t)) (dialog '(("king/king-1" "Good journey {{hero}}, I have faith in you.")))))
